requirement_text.ISS-0332: REQ-077 bumped the DEFINITION_PROMOTED platform-event-type seed from schema_version 1 (review_id required non-null) to schema_version 2 (review_id nullable) in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex. Pre-existing tenants' event_type_registry still has v1. R10 against such a tenant fails the event-append step after the promotion transaction commits -- Severity-1. Fix: backfill routine iterating tenant_schemas and calling register_type/2 per tenant for DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 attrs, no-op on higher-version collision.

task.description:
Implement the fix for ISS-0332 per lib/letflow/design/iss0332-definition-promoted-backfill.md (on branch feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826).

The design specifies:
1. New module Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Backfill at lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex with:
   @spec run(event_type_attrs :: map()) :: {:ok, %{updated: non_neg_integer(), skipped: non_neg_integer()}} | {:error, {:backfill_failed, Ecto.UUID.t(), term()}}
   - Queries all Registration records (tenant_schemas)
   - For each tenant, calls Letflow.EventStore.Registry.register_type/2 with the provided attrs and the tenant's tenant_id
   - {:ok, _} -> count as updated
   - {:error, :duplicate_event_type_version} -> count as skipped (already at exact version)
   - {:error, :schema_version_not_monotonic} -> count as skipped (already at higher version)
   - {:error, :tenant_not_provisioned} -> Logger.warning and count as skipped (anomaly)
   - {:error, other} -> return {:error, {:backfill_failed, tenant_id, other}} immediately

2. Mix task Mix.Tasks.Letflow.BackfillEventTypeVersions at lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.ex:
   - mix letflow.backfill_event_type_versions
   - Hardcodes the DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 attrs (name, schema_version: 2, description, json_schema)
   - Calls Backfill.run/1 and prints a summary
   - Check the json_schema for DEFINITION_PROMOTED v2 from lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex @platform_event_type_seed_attrs -- use the EXACT same schema (review_id type ['string','null'], all other fields unchanged from v1)

IMPORTANT constraints:
- Do NOT modify lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex (the KNOWN GAP comment stays -- the gap itself is fixed by the backfill, not by removing the comment)
- Do NOT modify lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex
- The Backfill module imports Letflow.Repo and Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration for the tenant list query
- Use Logger for the :tenant_not_provisioned anomaly case
- No new dependencies

After implementation:
1. git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826
2. Implement the two new files
3. Run mix compile -- fix any compile errors before proceeding
4. Run mix test --no-start to check for regressions (not adding new tests yet -- that's TEST-DESIGNER's job)
5. Commit: git add lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_event_type_versions.ex; git commit -m 'fix(ISS-0332): DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version 2 backfill [WF03-ISS0332-20260826]'
6. Push: git push origin feature/WF03-ISS0332-20260826
7. Update handoff on main: git checkout main; git pull --ff-only; git add handoffs/WF03-ISS0332-20260826/step-03-elixir-dev.json; git commit -m 'chore(ELIXIR-DEV): WF03-ISS0332-20260826 step-03 PASS'; git push origin main
acceptance_criteria: lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex exists with run/1 matching the design @spec
mix compile exits 0 with no new warnings
mix test exits 0 (no regression in existing tests)
No modification to lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex or lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex
